final_message:
All 3 tests pass. Here's what I implemented:

- `luhn_valid` — strips spaces/hyphens, validates digits-only and length >= 2, then applies the Luhn algorithm (double every 2nd digit from the right, subtract 9 if > 9, check sum % 10 == 0)
- `iban_valid` — strips spaces, uppercases, validates country/check-digit format, checks length against `IBAN_LENGTHS`, then computes `(account + country + check)` as a letter-to-number integer and verifies `% 97 == 1`
- `iban_check_digits` — validates country/account, builds `(account + country + "00")` as a letter-to-number integer, returns `98 - (% 97)` zero-padded to 2 digits

`_letters_to_num` is a shared helper that converts `A`→`10`, `B`→`11`, ..., `Z`→`35`.
